name: plain-language
title_zh: 术语堆三层就拆成三句人话的改写器
tagline_zh: AI 回复一句话塞三个概念？它按中文/英文各自的规则拆开重写，原意不动，密度降一半。
tagline_en: When AI output packs three ideas into one sentence, this rewrites it for instant clarity—Chinese and English each.
desc_en: 把繞口、術語堆疊、一句話塞三個概念的 AI 回覆或技術文字，改寫成人類一眼看懂的白話 —— 中文走中文的規則，英文走英文的規則，且都不改變原意。Rewrites convoluted AI output and technical writing into plain language a human gets on the first read; Chinese and English each have their own rule set. 當用戶說「白話」「翻成人話」「太繞口」「看不懂」，或說 "plain English"、"simplify this"、"too wordy"，或當你自己正要輸出一段密度過高的解釋時，載入這個 skill。
why_zh: 不靠通用「简化」模板，而是中英文分别有语法层拆句规则：先切意群，再换掉术语，最后验原意。
why_en: No generic simplification—it splits by meaning clusters, swaps jargon, then verifies intent. More reliable than just telling the.
limit_zh: 只处理文字，不处理图表/公式/代码。改写后保留原术语的首次出现（供上下文），但若原文本身逻辑混乱或信息缺失。
limit_en: Text only—no diagrams, formulas, or code. Keeps first mention of key terms for context; won't fix missing logic or info, only rephrases what's there.
title_en: Untangle jargon into plain language, one idea per sentence
